> **Superseded by D-20.** This note was written during the 2026-09-01T06:29Z JSONL wave, which mis-numbered a decision that collided with an existing id. That event is void. The authoritative record is D-20.

## Decision

Only hook registrations that both have a gw hook implementation and a green corpus-parity scenario move to gw hook <name>. Today that is 9 of 16 registrations. spec-guard, deslop-guard, prose-negation-guard, prose-modality-guard, doc-read-guard, doc-size-guard, and keyword-router have no gw hook implementation and MUST NOT be rewired.

## Rationale

Verified in source: src/gw/hook/index.ts registers exactly stop-gate, session-reminder, nesting-guard, agent-model-guard, orchestrator-impl-guard, ledger-guard, ledger-bash-guard, piped-exit-code-guard, struggle-detector. hooks/hooks.json registers 16 commands. Rewiring a name with no gw implementation would make the hook exit non-zero or no-op silently. Rollback stays one step because hooks/hooks.json is the only file the rewire slice touches.

## Alternatives Considered

- Port the seven missing hooks first, then rewire all 16 at once
- Rewire nothing until the whole hook set is ported
